title: 1.8 Systems of Linear Inequalities

icans: I can tell whether an ordered pair is a solution of a system of linear inequalities.
I can graph a system of linear inequalities.
I can write a system of linear inequalities from a graph or a real-life situation.

vocab: two or more linear inequalities in the same ____________
an ordered pair that makes every _____________ true
the region where the graphs of all the _______________ overlap

blocks.p: You have $60 for pizzas ($10 each, x) and packs of drinks ($5 each, y). You need at least 2 pizzas and at least 3 packs of drinks.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Solution of a system: A solution of a system makes _______________ inequality true.

blocks.stem:
Tell whether each point is a solution of the system  y ≥ x + 1  and  y < −2x + 5.
a.  (1, 2)        b.  (3, 0)

notes: Boundary lines: Dashed line for _______________; solid line for _______________.
Graph of a system: The graph of the system is the region where the shadings _______________.

blocks.stem: Graph the system  y > x − 2  and  y ≤ −x + 4. Name one solution.
The solution region lies on or below the solid line and above the dashed line. Write the system.
You can work at most 20 hours a week babysitting ($10 per hour) and tutoring ($15 per hour). You want to earn at least $240. Write a system and give one possible schedule.
Is (−1, 4) a solution of  y > −x + 2  and  y ≤ 3x + 8?
Graph  y < 2  and  x ≥ −1. Name one solution.

tickets.stem: Is (0, 0) a solution of  y < x + 3  and  y > −2?
Should the boundary line of y ≥ 4x − 1 be dashed or solid?
You can buy at most 12 items: x apples and y oranges. Write the inequality.
